title: Fitted wardrobe with six doors

options.name: The design
options.text: Three double units in MDF from floor to ceiling on a plinth, with six flat doors and wooden knobs. Inside, from the bottom: on the left 3 drawers, a shelf, short hanging and a top shelf; in the middle 3 shelves, long hanging and a top shelf; on the right 2 drawers, 2 shelves, short hanging and a top shelf.

poster.alt: 3D model of a six-door fitted wardrobe from floor to ceiling with drawers, shelves and hanging rails inside

notes: The width, height and depth are the sizes of the space.
The heights inside (drawers, shelves and rails) are standard ones to start from and can move to suit what you hang and store.
Made from 18 mm board, backs included, with an end panel at each side.
Colours on screen are a guide.
